## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.

  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive

formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in

**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

## Empowering Breakthroughs, Enhancing Lives.

Andelyn Biosciences is driven by its mission of accelerating the development and manufacturing of
innovative therapies to bring more treatments to more patients. Our dedication to scientific

## Empowering Breakthroughs, Enhancing Lives.

### A Journey of Innovation and Growth

Andelyn Biosciences is driven by its mission of accelerating the development and manufacturing of
innovative therapies to bring more treatments to more patients. Our dedication to scientific
excellence, collaborative partnerships, and reliable manufacturing reflects our commitment to meet
the current needs of the industry and to anticipate and shape its future. Through tech transfer of
established processes or the adoption of our data-driven and program-specific
Optimization-By-Design™ AAV Curator® Platform, together we strive to overcome the greatest
challenges in gene therapy: enabling our partners to deliver life-changing treatments to those in
need.

Our journey is a testament to our enduring commitment to advancing healthcare. Discover the
milestones and achievements that have shaped our vision of Turning Hope Into Reality™.

# UNLEASHING THE PROMISE OF T-CELL THERAPIES.

[ DISCOVER ATARA ][44]

## Cutting-edge science. A fresh approach.

Atara is an allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy company. We're harnessing the natural biology of T
cells—our body’s most effective weapon in fighting disease—to develop transformative therapies for
patients with cancer and autoimmune conditions.
* #### Off-the-shelf approach
  
  Allogeneic T-cell therapies can be readily available for rapid delivery within days.
* #### Scalable manufacturing
  
  Efficient, robust process with the ability to produce over a thousand doses from one healthy
  donor.
* #### Highly versatile platform
  
  Potential application for a wide range of disease-causing viral and non-viral targets.
[OUR TECHNOLOGY][45]

## We’re developing a pipeline of firsts.

Our investigational T-cell therapies target difficult-to-treat cancers and autoimmune conditions
that can be rapidly delivered to patients from inventory. We’re the first company ever to receive an
approval for an allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy.

# UNLEASHING THE PROMISE OF T-CELL THERAPIES.

[ DISCOVER ATARA ][44]

## Cutting-edge science. A fresh approach.

Atara is an allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy company. We're harnessing the natural biology of T
cells—our body’s most effective weapon in fighting disease—to develop transformative therapies for
patients with cancer and autoimmune conditions.
* #### Off-the-shelf approach
  
  Allogeneic T-cell therapies can be readily available for rapid delivery within days.
* #### Scalable manufacturing
  
  Efficient, robust process with the ability to produce over a thousand doses from one healthy
  donor.
* #### Highly versatile platform
  
  Potential application for a wide range of disease-causing viral and non-viral targets.
[OUR TECHNOLOGY][45]

## We’re developing a pipeline of firsts.

Our investigational T-cell therapies target difficult-to-treat cancers and autoimmune conditions
that can be rapidly delivered to patients from inventory. We’re the first company ever to receive an
approval for an allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy.

ATCC (American Type Culture Collection) is a nonprofit, global biological resource center and
standards organization and the leading developer and supplier of authenticated cells lines and
microorganisms. We leverage our rich history and knowledge to provide the products, services, and
resources scientists need to conduct critical life science research.

[Learn more][11]

### confidence, and reproducibility.

[Explore now][12]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

## 2nd Cell & Gene Therapy Global Congress 2024 Europe

The Fastest Growing Cell & Gene Therapy Networking Event. 
* Introduction
* Insight
* Who Should Attend

Cell and Gene therapies are forms of personalised, regenerative medicine. Described as the most
innovative, promising and life-changing new categories of medicines whose full potential is only
just beginning to emerge. They are cutting-edge and rapidly progressing fields of Biological
Therapies. Also known as “Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products”, they involved the use of cells,
tissues and genes to treat, prevent or potentially cure and eliminate complicated health conditions
and difficult to treat diseases. These therapies promise life-changing treatments for a broad
spectrum of complex diseases ranging from genetic conditions to cancers. Both approaches offer the
potential to diminish the fundamental cause of genetic and acquired diseases by substituting the
missing protein or cells causing the disease’s symptoms. Cell and gene therapies may offer longer
lasting effects than traditional medicines. Convergence of advanced biotechnology, precision
medicine, and expertise in manufacturing has facilitated the way for these therapies to become a
reality, with remarkable successes observed in conditions such as cancer and genetic disorders.

Cell and Gene therapy has transformed the healthcare and biopharma industry by storm. Currently,
after around 40 CGT launches across the EU and US, the market is worth around EUR 4.5 billion. A
similar number are expected to be approved by 2028, when sales are projected to rise to EUR 19.2
billion. The development of biological therapies is rapidly expanding, however, commercialisation of
this treatment poses different challenges to research and development, authorisation, manufacturing,
accessibility, and ensuring safety throughout the lifecycle of the product.

The two-day Congress will provide an interactive, cutting edge, and comprehensive discussions in
collaborative format led by key experts with intimate knowledge in the industry. Gain practical
strategies and best practices on challenges, innovations, technologies, and concepts to help you
gain access to the booming CGT market.

We are putting together an agenda that focuses on “driving innovation, addressing significant unmet
medical needs, and ultimately improving patient outcomes”.

We are gathering high calibre expert speakers to participate and share their knowledge and expertise
through Keynote Presentations and Panel discussions, addressing all aspects of the industry.

We look forward to welcoming you to the **CGT World Congress 2024!**

Sincerely yours,
Jocelyn Raguindin
Conference Director

## 2nd Cell & Gene Therapy Global Congress 2024 Europe

The Fastest Growing Cell & Gene Therapy Networking Event. 
* Introduction
* Insight
* Who Should Attend

Cell and Gene therapies are forms of personalised, regenerative medicine. Described as the most
innovative, promising and life-changing new categories of medicines whose full potential is only
just beginning to emerge. They are cutting-edge and rapidly progressing fields of Biological
Therapies. Also known as “Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products”, they involved the use of cells,
tissues and genes to treat, prevent or potentially cure and eliminate complicated health conditions
and difficult to treat diseases. These therapies promise life-changing treatments for a broad
spectrum of complex diseases ranging from genetic conditions to cancers. Both approaches offer the
potential to diminish the fundamental cause of genetic and acquired diseases by substituting the
missing protein or cells causing the disease’s symptoms. Cell and gene therapies may offer longer
lasting effects than traditional medicines. Convergence of advanced biotechnology, precision
medicine, and expertise in manufacturing has facilitated the way for these therapies to become a
reality, with remarkable successes observed in conditions such as cancer and genetic disorders.

Cell and Gene therapy has transformed the healthcare and biopharma industry by storm. Currently,
after around 40 CGT launches across the EU and US, the market is worth around EUR 4.5 billion. A
similar number are expected to be approved by 2028, when sales are projected to rise to EUR 19.2
billion. The development of biological therapies is rapidly expanding, however, commercialisation of
this treatment poses different challenges to research and development, authorisation, manufacturing,
accessibility, and ensuring safety throughout the lifecycle of the product.

The two-day Congress will provide an interactive, cutting edge, and comprehensive discussions in
collaborative format led by key experts with intimate knowledge in the industry. Gain practical
strategies and best practices on challenges, innovations, technologies, and concepts to help you
gain access to the booming CGT market.

We are putting together an agenda that focuses on “driving innovation, addressing significant unmet
medical needs, and ultimately improving patient outcomes”.

We are gathering high calibre expert speakers to participate and share their knowledge and expertise
through Keynote Presentations and Panel discussions, addressing all aspects of the industry.

We look forward to welcoming you to the **CGT World Congress 2024!**

Sincerely yours,
Jocelyn Raguindin
Conference Director

## to deliver innovation

## at the speed of life.

We’re Danaher - a leading global life sciences and diagnostics innovator, committed to accelerating
the power of science and technology to improve human health.

[A microscopic image of a cell]

Our businesses
Biotechnology
[A microscopic image of a cell]

Advancements in healthcare and medicine are moving at an unprecedented pace with a promising
pipeline of innovative drugs on the horizon that are more targeted, personalized, and effective than
ever before. Our biotechnology business brings expertise, technologies, and services that accelerate
the development and commercialization of these life-changing therapies, ensuring that they can be
delivered quickly and safely to the patients who need them.

[Learn about biotechnology][66]
Diagnostics
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

There is an urgent need for better, more expansive health care—and we’re ready to meet it. Our
diagnostics businesses create tools and software designed to improve confidence in precise and rapid
diagnoses.

[Learn about diagnostics ][67]
Life Sciences
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]

In a world that’s ever-changing, our customers work to advance innovations that improve human
health. Our life sciences businesses power tools and technologies that support our customers in a
wide range of critical activities, whether it’s creating breakthrough cell and gene therapies,
ensuring high-quality fluid filtration in labs, or driving the latest advances in molecular
oncology.           

[Learn about life sciences][68]

This is how Danaher brings innovation at the speed of life to the world—by connecting science,
accelerating progress, and delivering impact at global scale.

familiar, sophisticated but unfussy. The menu is seasonal new-American with a wine-forward beverage
program. With a commitment to quality, every ingredient & bottle will tell a story. It's a spot for
making memories - from date night to catch-up-time with a close friend to celebrating over countless
bottles of wine and as many dishes as you can share.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

## Fortrea Forms Strategic Collaboration with SCTbio to Advance Cell Therapy Development

Fortrea announces a strategic collaboration with SCTbio, a leader in cGMP manufacturing for
cell-based therapies and viral vectors. This partnership combines Fortrea’s clinical development
expertise with SCTbio’s manufacturing capabilities to deliver integrated, end-to-end solutions for
cell therapy innovators—streamlining timelines, reducing risks, and accelerating the delivery of
life-changing therapies worldwide.

# The Human Gene Database

GeneCards is a searchable, integrative database that provides comprehensive, user-friendly
information on all annotated and predicted human genes. The knowledgebase automatically integrates
gene-centric data from 193 web sources, including genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, genetic,
clinical and functional information.

Comprehensive integrated information on all annotated human genes from 193 sources.

e.g.
* NFE2L2
* MALAT1
* prostate cancer

## Explore a Gene

Examples: Eg:
* NFE2L2
* MALAT1

## Search GeneCards for any term

Examples: Eg:
* collagen
* "prostate cancer"
* metabolism

# The Human Gene Database

GeneCards is a searchable, integrative database that provides comprehensive, user-friendly
information on all annotated and predicted human genes. The knowledgebase automatically integrates
gene-centric data from 193 web sources, including genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, genetic,
clinical and functional information.

Comprehensive integrated information on all annotated human genes from 193 sources.

e.g.
* NFE2L2
* MALAT1
* prostate cancer

We’re a technical and quality-focused CDMO dedicated to advancing gene and cell therapies by
providing cutting-edge viral vector services and manufacturing solutions. When you’re ready to start
or shift your CDMO journey, our team offers the expertise, technology, and flexibility to help bring
your viral vector-based therapy to patients.

#### Lentiviral Vector CDMO Services

Starting from plasmid design and cell line development all the way through to manufacturing, we
provide world-class lentiviral vector support to bring innovative therapies to fruition.

#### Retroviral Vector CDMO Services

Delivering larger batches with greater consistency and reliability, we support you with the latest
technologies from a state-of-the-art facility that is designed with the aseptic manufacture of
retroviral vectors in mind.

#### Cell Therapy CDMO Services

Leverage our world-class partnerships, streamline your production, and advance your cell therapy to
trial and beyond.

#### Plasmid Design

Whether utilizing our preferred partners’ proven platforms or working with your plasmids, we adapt
to your unique requirements, fostering collaboration for mutual success.

#### Adeno-Associated Viral Vector CDMO Services

With more than a decade’s worth of experience building diverse AAV platforms, processes, and
analytics, our team has the knowledge and skill necessary to bring your program from molecule to
medicine.

#### Collaborative Project Management

Our team is your team; dedicated partnership and flexible support that molds to your needs.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

Capsules

Wide range of capsules that are available as antibiotic capsules, pain killer capsules, vitamin
supplements & tonics.

Injectables

Safe and reliable injectables that are
available in both powder and liquid
form.

Dry Syrups & Suspensions

We bring to you highly reliable formulation in the form of dry syrup for effective treatment of
variety of ailments.

Eye Drops & Ear Drops

Highly effective eye and ear drops that provide quick relief. These products are available in
sterilized and safe vials.

External Preparation

Avail from us a variety of external application products including ointments, creams and
antiseptic/disinfectants.

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

does globally, interfacing with regional leaders who coordinate activities in their parts of the
world. Adventists are an extremely diverse, international family of Christians. We exist to help
people everywhere understand the Bible to find freedom, healing and hope in Jesus Christ. Thanks for
checking out our site!

#### Detailed Market Analysis

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

# **GMP** Modular **Clean Room Manufacturer **

Design and Engineering. Manufacturing. Cleanroom Installation.

[Download Brochure][52]­

[[Modular Cleanroom Bay Window]][53]

## [Modular: **Free-Standing & Self-Supporting**][54]

Our modular clean room concept is an independent self-standing building using prefabricated panels.
One of our many unique advantages is our free-standing walls with a fully load-bearing ceiling.

[Learn more about our Modular Cleanroom System][55]
[[Basic 3D model of a modular cleanroom]][56]

## [**FINANCIAL PLANNING** FOR YOUR CLEANROOM][57]

Mecart’s custom cleanroom build outs vary in price from project to project, depending on customer
requirements, cleanroom classification, and industry-specific regulations.** **

[Learn more about the Cost Of A Cleanroom][58]
[[Mecart HVAC for cleanroom]][59]

## [HVAC **VENTILATION SYSTEM** FOR **CLEANROOMS**][60]

The clean room HVAC system is at the heart of your clean room and should not be taken lightly.
Mecart will analyze all the aspects of the clean room ventilation system in order to design and
build a compliant clean room that exceeds your requirements.

[Learn more about our HVAC][61]

## **ISO COMPLIANT CLEANROOMS: CUSTOM DESIGN & RAPID INSTALL**

With over 4000+ completed ISO compliant cleanrooms, you can trust Mecart’s expertise to design,
build, and install your next modular cleanroom independently or by partnering with
other professionals already in your network.

[Contact Us][62]

## **Cleanroom Projects**

 

[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom]][63]

### **Vaccine Manufacturing Facility**

MECART was tasked with creating 14,000 square feet of Class B, C, and D clean rooms that adhered to
GMP standards for vaccine development. The entire facility was delivered in less than 10 months!

[View this vaccine production cleanroom case study][64]
[[Medical Device Manufacturing Clean Room – 20,000 SQFT - 700x450px]][65]

### **Medical Device Manufacturing Clean Room – 20,000 SQFT**

The cleanroom is divided into 5 rooms, including a molding room, quality assurance (QA) lab, gowning
room, and multiple material airlocks (MAL) and personal airlocks (PAL).

[View this medical device cleanroom case study][66]
[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom (2)]][67]

### **Class 10,000 Clean Room for SMT Manufacturing in a Semiconductor Fab**

This semiconductor fab required more than 9,000 square feet of Class 10,000 clean room space (ISO 7
cleanroom) for PCB and SMT manufacturing, technologies that will change the electric car sector.

[View this semiconductor cleanroom case study][68]
[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom (3)]][69]

### **mRNA and Plasmid DNA Manufacturing Cleanroom for a Biotech CDMO**

Their biomanufacturing facility contains an ISO 6 fill/finish suite, three ISO 7 manufacturing
laboratories, an ISO 7 master cell banking cleanroom, and an ISO 8 gowning room.

[View this biotech cleanroom case study][70]
[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom (4)]][71]

### **Prefab Modular Hospital**

The prefab modular hospital needed several isolation rooms, 36 prefab individual patient rooms
spread over 2 floors. The isolation rooms were designed for an immuno-oncology center that treats
cancer patients.

[View this healthcare cleanroom case study][72]
[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom (5)]][73]

### **503B Cleanroom for Outsourcing and Repackaging Facility**

The 503B compounding pharmacy operates under an ISO 7 cleanliness level with an ISO 8 background
zone.

[View the 503B cleanroom case study][74]

# **GMP** Modular **Clean Room Manufacturer **

Design and Engineering. Manufacturing. Cleanroom Installation.

[Download Brochure][52]­

[[Modular Cleanroom Bay Window]][53]

## [Modular: **Free-Standing & Self-Supporting**][54]

Our modular clean room concept is an independent self-standing building using prefabricated panels.
One of our many unique advantages is our free-standing walls with a fully load-bearing ceiling.

[Learn more about our Modular Cleanroom System][55]
[[Basic 3D model of a modular cleanroom]][56]

## [**FINANCIAL PLANNING** FOR YOUR CLEANROOM][57]

Mecart’s custom cleanroom build outs vary in price from project to project, depending on customer
requirements, cleanroom classification, and industry-specific regulations.** **

[Learn more about the Cost Of A Cleanroom][58]
[[Mecart HVAC for cleanroom]][59]

## [HVAC **VENTILATION SYSTEM** FOR **CLEANROOMS**][60]

The clean room HVAC system is at the heart of your clean room and should not be taken lightly.
Mecart will analyze all the aspects of the clean room ventilation system in order to design and
build a compliant clean room that exceeds your requirements.

[Learn more about our HVAC][61]

## **ISO COMPLIANT CLEANROOMS: CUSTOM DESIGN & RAPID INSTALL**

With over 4000+ completed ISO compliant cleanrooms, you can trust Mecart’s expertise to design,
build, and install your next modular cleanroom independently or by partnering with
other professionals already in your network.

[Contact Us][62]

## **Cleanroom Projects**

 

[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom]][63]

### **Vaccine Manufacturing Facility**

MECART was tasked with creating 14,000 square feet of Class B, C, and D clean rooms that adhered to
GMP standards for vaccine development. The entire facility was delivered in less than 10 months!

[View this vaccine production cleanroom case study][64]
[[Medical Device Manufacturing Clean Room – 20,000 SQFT - 700x450px]][65]

### **Medical Device Manufacturing Clean Room – 20,000 SQFT**

The cleanroom is divided into 5 rooms, including a molding room, quality assurance (QA) lab, gowning
room, and multiple material airlocks (MAL) and personal airlocks (PAL).

[View this medical device cleanroom case study][66]
[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom (2)]][67]

### **Class 10,000 Clean Room for SMT Manufacturing in a Semiconductor Fab**

This semiconductor fab required more than 9,000 square feet of Class 10,000 clean room space (ISO 7
cleanroom) for PCB and SMT manufacturing, technologies that will change the electric car sector.

[View this semiconductor cleanroom case study][68]
[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom (3)]][69]

### **mRNA and Plasmid DNA Manufacturing Cleanroom for a Biotech CDMO**

Their biomanufacturing facility contains an ISO 6 fill/finish suite, three ISO 7 manufacturing
laboratories, an ISO 7 master cell banking cleanroom, and an ISO 8 gowning room.

[View this biotech cleanroom case study][70]
[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom (4)]][71]

### **Prefab Modular Hospital**

The prefab modular hospital needed several isolation rooms, 36 prefab individual patient rooms
spread over 2 floors. The isolation rooms were designed for an immuno-oncology center that treats
cancer patients.

[View this healthcare cleanroom case study][72]
[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom (5)]][73]

### **503B Cleanroom for Outsourcing and Repackaging Facility**

The 503B compounding pharmacy operates under an ISO 7 cleanliness level with an ISO 8 background
zone.

[View the 503B cleanroom case study][74]

## Your full-service CDMO partner

Miltenyi Bioindustry supports all efforts, from pre-clinical to commercial scale, as a
full-service provider for the development and manufacturing of lentiviral vectors (LVVs) and cell
and gene therapy (CGT) products. As a globally active CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing
Organization) with 25 years of extensive know-how, we are helping to shape this rapidly growing
arena.  We leverage the latest technology platforms to make your vision of commercial-scale
manufacturing a reality. We are a division of Miltenyi Biotec, a pioneering innovator and provider
of cell processing and analytical platforms, LVVs, and ancillary materials in this field.




## Cell and gene therapy process development and manufacturing

We make your product ready for clinical trials and towards commercial roll-out. Miltenyi Biotec’s
proven manufacturing and analysis platforms comprise closed and integrated solutions that help
advance your process to commercial scale.
 

[Our cell therapy services][34]


## Lentiviral vector optimization and manufacturing

From LVV design and selection to small-scale evaluation and commercial-scale manufacturing, we
support customers at various scales. With decades of experience and a scalable LVV platform, we
offer fast and consistent production of high-quality vectors with minimal process development.
 

[Our LVV services][35]






## Regulatory support services

Our global quality and regulatory teams support your project from pre-IND to market approval. We
have the experience and the documentation to accelerate your regulatory submissions.
 

[Our regulatory support][36]


## Our mission

Our mission is to improve the availability and affordability of advanced CGT products. We do so by
providing solutions that propel manufacturing of cell therapies for translation into the clinic and
the market. We provide services, expertise, and technologies to leading researchers, biotech
companies, and large corporates to take their cell and gene therapy products to the next level.

# Every Breakthrough
# Begins with Belief

[decorative diamond pattern]

**Gene therapy holds incredible promise** to revolutionize medical treatment. At Neurogene we
believe that innovation, robust scientific execution and a strong sense of purpose are required to
turn this promise into reality. Our focus is to develop life-changing genetic medicines for people
and their families impacted by devastating neurological diseases.

[**Get to know our story**][35]

## A passion for serving patients and their families

We listen to patients and families and incorporate their perspectives into our work, striving to
support them throughout our research and development process and beyond.

[See how we are making a difference][36]

## Gene therapies for rare neurological disorders

We are advancing a gene therapy pipeline to help address the high unmet need for rare neurological
diseases, with a focus on Rett syndrome.

[Learn about NGN-401 Gene Therapy][37]

## A differentiated platform technology

We leverage our proprietary transgene regulation technology to open up new possibilities for rare
neurological diseases.

[Learn about our EXACT™ technology][38]
[Girl with Rett syndrome]

### Pursuing a Brighter Future, Together

We own our responsibility to provide transparent updates on our progress on an ongoing basis to
those in the patient communities we serve. This partnership is critical to advance a potential
one-time treatment for a rare neurodevelopmental disorder like Rett syndrome.

[**Read Our Community Letters**][39]

## Patients and families are at the core of our work.

We recognize and honor that it is their contributions that make scientific advances possible. We
strive to support them throughout their participation in clinical research.

# Manufacturing Excellence for Transformative Therapies

## Your Lifelong Cell and Gene Therapy CDMO Partner

[ Explore Our Services ][68]

## Bringing Your Cell and Gene Therapy to Life

Selecting a cell and gene therapy contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) partner
is critical. At OmniaBio, we revolutionize cell and gene therapy manufacturing to enhance the
affordability and accessibility of treatments. With decades of collective experience in both
autologous and allogeneic cell therapies, we navigate the complexities of process development and
GMP manufacturing to advance your program efficiently.

Our dedication to innovation and collaboration ensures that we are not just a CGT CDMO, but a true
innovation partner in bringing your groundbreaking therapies to life for patients in need.

[ Request A Consult ][69]
[commercial-capacity-logo]
Early development to commercial capacity
[flex-scalable-updated]
Flexible, scalable technology solutions
[ai-manufacturing-icon]
AI-enabled development and GMP manufacturing

## Seamless Transition from Early Development to Commercial Supply

Our expertise in advanced manufacturing services ensures the reliable execution needed to propel
your program forward. Our comprehensive suite of services seamlessly merges technical proficiency in
cell-based processes and gene delivery tools with cutting-edge advancements in process development
and manufacturing. This integration provides holistic capabilities that span the entire product
lifecycle – from preclinical development to large-scale commercial manufacturing.
With a variety of GMP suite options (Grade B or Grade C), we deliver GMP manufacturing of cell
therapies that comply with U.S., Canadian, and European regulations. Trust us to guide your journey
toward compliant, scalable, and cost-effective manufacturing.

## Advancing Autologous Cell Therapies with Robust, Scalable Solutions

With over a decade of experience developing immune cell-based therapy processes, our team of
technical experts specializes in developing and optimizing manufacturing platforms. We integrate
closed-unit systems, AI models, and robotics to create robust, scalable, and efficient processes
tailored to your needs.

#### Process Development

Process development and optimization expertise for enhanced robustness and reliable scale-up.
[ Explore Process Development ][70]

#### Analytical Development

Comprehensive analytical development services for tailored and established assays.
[ EXPLORE ANALYTICAL DEVELOPMENT ][71]

#### Autologous Manufacturing

Hamilton Intelligent Facility: AI and robotics integration for enhanced production rates and reduced
costs.
[ EXPLORE AUTOLOGOUS MANUFACTURING ][72]

#### Platform Expertise

Cutting-edge cell platforms for lentiviral vector-, immune cell- and iPSC-based therapies.
[ EXPLORE OUR PLATFORMS ][73]

#### GMP Manufacturing

Resilient manufacturing for consistent quality, certified compliance, and minimal risks at every
stage.
[ EXPLORE GMP MANUFACTURING ][74]

#### Commercial Manufacturing

Efficient scalability, timely QC release, and reliable delivery to support your commercial goals.
[ EXPLORE COMMERCIAL MANUFACTURING ][75]

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Evolving the Potential of Cell and Gene Therapies via Engineering and Collaboration

Our team has spent more than a decade working to overcome the challenges of processing personalized
cell and gene therapies (CGTs) locally, so that we can impact the lives of patients globally.

Orgenesis is paving the way to drastically lower costs for higher quality, standardized CGTs,
regardless of patient location.

Personalized cell and gene therapies (CGTs) offer potential to address the world’s most challenging
diseases. We are committed to helping to bring these advanced therapies to market effectively.

Our team has spent more than a decade working to overcome the challenges of processing personalized
cell and gene therapies (CGTs) locally, so that we can impact the lives of patients globally.

Orgenesis is paving the way to drastically lower costs for higher quality, standardized CGTs,
regardless of patient location.

diseases. We are committed to helping to bring these advanced therapies to market effectively.

We are driven by a single mission: to transform patient outcomes by building the connections that

At Phacilitate, we don’t just bring people together, we create exceptional, high-impact experiences

We believe true innovation happens when collaboration takes center stage. The whole is greater than
the sum of its parts, and by fostering powerful partnerships and open knowledge exchange, we help
accelerate therapies from breakthrough to patient, where they matter most.

### Connecting the Global Advanced Therapies Community to Accelerate Patient Access

For 24 years, Phacilitate has united the global advanced therapies ecosystem to accelerate the
development and delivery of life-changing cell and gene therapies. Through strategic events,
partnerships, and insights, we support biotech companies at every stage of their commercialization
journey — helping them connect with investors, navigate regulation, and bring transformative
treatments to patients faster.

## Have a Question?


### Who are Phacilitate?

Phacilitate is a global platform serving the advanced therapies industry through events, content,
research, networking and industry intelligence. We connect the people responsible for developing,
manufacturing, funding, regulating and commercialising cell and gene therapies.

### What industries does Phacilitate serve?

Phacilitate serves professionals across the advanced therapies ecosystem, including biotechnology
companies, pharmaceutical organisations, investors, academics, regulators, healthcare providers,
manufacturers, technology providers and patient-focused organisations.

### What topics in gene therapy are covered at these events?

Across all three events, gene therapy is a core focus. Sessions span clinical trials, molecular
therapy innovations, CRISPR-based therapy, CAR T therapy, and the evolving regulatory landscape for
gene therapies. You’ll also explore key themes such as patient access, platform scalability, and
approaches to gene therapy research.

### Where and when are the upcoming events?

[Advanced Therapies Europe][28] - September 7-9, 2026 in Barcelona, Spain 

[Advanced Therapies World][29] - December 5-6, 2026 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia 

[Advanced Therapies Week][30] - January 18-21, 2027 in San Diego, USA 

### Who will I meet if I attend?

You’ll connect with global leaders across the cell and gene therapy ecosystem, including therapeutic
developers, regulators, investors, CROs, CDMOs, academics, and patient advocates. Whether you’re
seeking strategic partnerships or clinical collaborators, these events bring the right people
together.

### What kind of speakers can I expect?

Expect to hear from CEOs of pioneering biotech companies, clinical leaders, regulators from the FDA
and EMA, and research scientists shaping the future of gene therapy. Many are directly involved in
recent gene therapy approvals or are breaking ground in next-gen platforms and clinical
applications.

more effectively, you’ll find actionable insights grounded in real-world data and experience.

Yes. Sessions include direct input from patient advocates, covering topics such as ethical trial
design, informed consent, and real-world barriers to patient access. These perspectives are critical

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,

# DON’T DIE

Humanity’s plan as we evolve from Homo Sapiens to Homo Evolutis.

## **Bryan’s Protocol**

Hi friends,

We might be the first generation that doesn’t die. To that end, my team and I have spent the last
few years building the world’s first Don’t Die protocol. 

Some of you don’t care about Don’t Die, you just want to be hot. That’s cool too. It’s really the
same thing.

To make this Don’t Die thing understandable, I’ve made it into a game because humans love games.
You’ll learn how to flex your biomarkers with friends. You’ll be able to share the science with
friends on why poor sleep is a terrible idea.

Personally, I have kind of taken this whole thing to the extreme. There’s the world’s fastest
person, and the richest, but never before has there been the “Healthiest Person in the World.” 

I’ve tried to become that person. I am certainly the most biologically measured person ever. 

Online, people refer to me as “immortal unc.” That’s what we care about. We are family and we care
about your well-being. In fact, I want to be the strongest voice in your mind encouraging you to
make health your top life priority.

To remind you that you will be a better father, mother, brother, sister, friend, colleague, and
human when you do so.

If you’re new to this game of health, don’t worry. I made disastrous health decisions in life until
I was 42 and my body has bounced back. No matter your situation, you can too.

Below I’m going to share everything my team and I have learned over the past few years, spending
millions of dollars researching, experimenting and measuring. We’ve made the mistakes for you.

Know that we are also hard at work to make all of this easier, more accessible and fun.

We are living in the most exciting time in human history. The future is probably cooler than
anything we can imagine. Our goal is to get there, together. 

Don’t Die,Bryan Johnson
Planet Earth, 2026

* blood sugar control: better than 99% of 18-25-year-olds

I share this to give you hope that you can meaningfully change your health for the better. There are
of course limitations with today’s science, but more can be accomplished than most people think.

hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

Stop Drowning in Data: Meet Synapse Lens, the Ultimate Reading Assistant for Biomed Professionals
][5]
5 February 2026
If you’ve ever felt overwhelmed by the sheer volume of reading required to stay ahead, there is a
